Presentations · free, in your browser

A free PowerPoint alternative in your browser

Presentations covers the everyday deck: themes, layouts, text, shapes, pictures, transitions and a full-screen slideshow, in a browser tab with nothing to install.

Open Presentations

How to do it

  1. Open Presentations and pick a template or a blank deck.
  2. Add slides, text, shapes and pictures, and choose a theme.
  3. Add transitions and animations, then press Present to rehearse.
  4. Export PowerPoint (.pptx) when you need to share it.

Your files stay on this device: Presentations runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Presentations made by Microsoft?

No. ITpris Verktyg is not affiliated with Microsoft. Microsoft and PowerPoint are trademarks of their owner, named here only to describe what people search for.

Can it open .pptx files?

Not yet. Presentations writes .pptx files, but opening them is not built. A picture can be imported to start a new deck.

Do I need an account?

No. Decks are saved to Files in this browser. There is no sign-up.

What is kept in the PowerPoint export?

Slides, text, shapes and pictures. Transitions, animations, tables, charts and media are not written to the .pptx yet; the app tells you when something is left out.
